definitions: To initiate or create the conditions for something to happen, especially something negative or problematic.
To begin a process that will lead to a particular result.
examples: His controversial speech sowed the seeds of discontent among the population.
The new policy could sow the seeds of future economic problems.
Their early collaboration sowed the seeds for a lasting partnership.
lemma: to sow the seeds of something
synonyms: to lay the groundwork for something
to set the stage for something
to plant the seeds of something
source: to sow the seeds of something
